release.effect: controller exits and no-takeover reacquisition succeeds

unsupported.localAgentReplacement: not exposed by verified public CLI and therefore not authorized for writable control

unsupported.slowConsumer: upstream backpressure cannot be deterministically injected; the product bridge must release on its own queue limit
unsupported.sequenceGapInjection: not safely injectable upstream; the parser guard rejects any observed gap
